competing_frames.summary: Defense team is deliberately slowing trial by refusing to stipulate facts and using semantic evasion to avoid legal admissions
Impeachment trial is following proper constitutional procedures with live coverage, quorum declarations, and witness testimony on confidential fund documentation
Trial proceeds with procedural appearance while four senators aren't constitutionally 'sitting for the purpose,' actual fund recipients remain unnamed, and audit methodology stays undisclosed
Careful vocabulary control treats one-word gaps (implemented vs. disbursed) as legal firewalls while confirming operational involvement
